notes: Personal AI center weekly mood chart, positive mood dynamics and detailed history use actual positive entries (joy/love) rather than negative percentages.
Personal AI center overview and detailed analysis gain improved visual hierarchy and responsive design.
Detailed AI report prioritizes insights, changes, next steps and cautious conditional conclusions; raw facts are collapsible evidence.
Avoid duplicate buttons for opening an already generated daily report.
Edge swipe from left to right closes the personal AI center detail sheet or returns from personal center to RUDI, while preserving vertical scrolling.
Regression checks for positive indicators, report insight hierarchy, design and swipe behavior.
Release requires explicit user confirmation before any production deployment.
versionPolicy: Один пакет изменений = один production deploy. Сначала проверка и PR, затем подтверждение пользователя.
